status: Available style specification; final outputs require format-specific visual checks
source: Original interpretations of style names demonstrated in a user-supplied video; not recovered source code.
quality_checks: Readable text and measured contrast against rendered colors
No information communicated by color alone
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow
Content remains readable without blur or animation

motion.reduced_motion: Remove decorative movement and nonessential transitions

name: Gradient mesh
summary: Broad fields of color create atmosphere without adding clutter.
use_when: Use for learning hubs, editorial introductions, and product overview pages.
avoid_when: Use sparingly in dense reading and preserve stable, high-contrast text surfaces.
typography: System sans-serif with spacious bold headings.
layout: Large diffuse color fields and clean aligned content panels.
surfaces: Soft overlapping violet, blue, and rose gradients behind solid text surfaces.

adaptations.web: Use the tokens and live components; validate keyboard, mobile, contrast, and reduced motion.
adaptations.slides: Preserve hierarchy and palette with native editable shapes and text. Replace motion with static emphasis.
adaptations.documents: Use native headings, readable body text, restrained callouts, and solid reading surfaces.
adaptations.images: Describe composition and material cues; check text and layout separately. Do not claim pixel-exact token fidelity.

prompt: Apply Gradient mesh to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. System sans-serif with spacious bold headings. Large diffuse color fields and clean aligned content panels. Soft overlapping violet, blue, and rose gradients behind solid text surfaces. Palette: background #202050, surface #282a5a, text #f8f6ff, muted #d4d0ee, accent #efe0ff, border #777ab0. Essential traits: Diffuse color transitions; Simple content structure; Stable text backgrounds. Avoid: Gradients behind dense text; Competing focal points; Color used as status alone. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
